caption: The drawing depicts a beige or light tan background with a central area featuring various blue, cloud-like shapes and abstract forms, some of which resemble swirling or looping brushstrokes. At the top center of the image, there is text that reads "T.G. BOONE & SONS, SANDS ST. BROOKLYN," arranged in a slight arc. To the right of this text, there is an outlined drawing of a jar with a lid, labeled with the same text, showing a simplified face on its surface rendered in similar blue brushstrokes. The artist's name, "John Tirimind," is signed at the lower left edge of the drawing. The overall composition combines the use of blue pigment for both the text and the central abstract forms, with the outlined jar situated in the upper right quadrant.
title: Crock
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
